notes: Strip d: x 5560-7160 plus overlap 5260-7460, full height. Thin solid lines inside the streets are water pipes, a few px off centre; centres were checked against block edges/corners. Washington printed 'WASHINGTON' NW of Floral, '2ND' SE of Floral (2nd Avenue; suffix from strip e). Smith Road: 'SMITH' on NW leg ('ROAD' read on SE leg by strip e). Cavagna, Madison, Monroe, Jefferson, Adams, Grove, Floral, Forest, Williams carry 'AVE'/'AVENUE' labels in or near the strip. Jefferson and Grove both jog east across Williams (two T points each). Unnamed N-S street leaving the top edge at the Floral/Smith junction recorded as '?'. Duck Creek Road is the diagonal road along the SE side of Duck Creek in the south (name as strip e read it; in this strip only 'DUCK CREEK' is printed, at the bridge); its centre taken midway between the creek bank and the SE road line. Not streets: railroads/tracks in Forest, Duck Creek, grey/pink/orange/teal boundary bands, subdivision lettering (SOUTH NORWOOD, B O, N...S etc.), the key box.
